scientific_integrity: Exact finite certificate with separately explained complete chamber enumeration, angle calculations, and adjacency. No numerical tolerances or random sampling are needed for the theorem.
scientific_limitations: Orthographic generic views only; exact finite circle-arrangement classification for one regular solid. Related classical icosahedral 31-circle grids and marginal silhouette formulas create historical priority uncertainty; no broader universality claim.
title: The four-class viewing atlas of the regular icosidodecahedron
